title: SB LIX dancer found guilty of resisting officer

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: SB LIX dancer found guilty of resisting officer
sources.description: Zul-Qarnain Kwame Nantambu was found guilty of resisting an officer charge, a misdemeanor, after disrupting Kendrick Lamar's Super Bowl halftime performance with a flag that read "Sudan and Free Gaza."
